name: Phosphor
tagline: Green text. Black glass. No lies.
jobs: Dev tools, CI, logs, status pages

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Page ground. Black glass in Night; a printout in Paper.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, fields, menus.

tokens.name: glass-sunk
tokens.usage: Log wells, code, inactive tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between log lines and table rows.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 1px outline on controls and panels. In Night it is the phosphor itself.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Pale green-white in Night so the glow has somewhere to go.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, dimmed log lines.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The brand and the pass state. Primary actions, the prompt, the cursor.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on green fills.

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: links, the active line.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for pass rows and selected lines.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The attention colour: focus ring, warnings, the one thing running now.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on amber fills.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning rows.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Pass. Shares green: in Phosphor, green means it worked.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Flaky, pending, retrying.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Fail. The only red on the screen.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for failed rows and error callouts.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Second chart series and the diff-added colour. Never for state.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

type_roles.name: display-xl
type_roles.usage: One per page. Covers and the headline state of a system.

type_roles.name: body
type_roles.sample: Tests ran on 4 workers in 3m 12s. The flaky suite retried once.
type_roles.usage: Default reading text. Everything is mono; the rhythm comes from leading.

type_roles.name: label
type_roles.usage: Eyebrows and column heads. Caps through CSS.

type_roles.name: log
type_roles.usage: Log lines and commands. Prefixed by a prompt glyph, never a box.

idea_headline: A terminal that tells the truth.
idea: Phosphor is the green screen with the lies removed: one monospace face at every size, light that glows instead of shadows that fall, a prompt instead of a hero. It belongs to tools whose readers already trust the terminal and want the web page to behave like it.
use_for: CI dashboards, log viewers, status pages, developer docs, release notes, anything a person reads while something is running.
avoid_when: Marketing, long prose, consumer subjects, or any page where more than two colours need to mean something at once.
principles_headline: One face, two colours, three states.
principles: IBM Plex Mono from the 88px headline to the 13px log line. Hierarchy comes from size, weight 500 or 700, and leading, never a second family.
Green is pass, amber is now, red is fail.
Three states, three colours, nothing else carries meaning. A fourth status colour is a bug.
Depth is light: a 12px green glow on the thing that is live. Nothing casts a shadow because nothing is above the glass.
A page opens on a command and its result, not on a slogan. The reader is a person at a terminal.
Zero radius, 1px edges, no fills on buttons but the primary. The grid shows through: dots at 16px are the page texture.
voice: Lowercase commands, sentence-case prose. Never shout in caps outside a label.
Say what ran: "Tests ran on 4 workers in 3m 12s", not "All good!"
Errors show the failing line and the fix. No apologies.
Timestamps everywhere; a figure without a time is a rumour.
colour_headline: Phosphor green on black glass; ink on a printout by day.
colour_note: Night is the native mode: the glass is nearly black, green is both brand and pass, and amber marks the one thing happening now. Paper is a printout of the same screen, with the greens darkened to read. Chart series stay away from the three state colours where they can.
chart_note: Green leads because it is the brand; cyan and violet exist only for charts so series never impersonate a state. Amber is third and should appear only when a series is literally the running one.
type_note: One family, four weights. The headline is bold mono with tight tracking; the body is regular mono at a generous 24px leading so paragraphs read as prose, not code. Log lines are the smallest role and get a prompt glyph.
space_headline: A 16px dot grid and a 4px baseline.
space: Between a glyph and its label; log line padding.
The dot-grid pitch; control padding-x; panel gap.
edges: Everything. Phosphor has no rounded corners, including the switch, which is a square slider.
Every panel and control has a 1px edge in the edge colour. No 2px, no double rules.
Between log lines and table rows. Never a box around a single line.
depth: 0 0 12px green at 45%. The live job, the focused field, the primary button on hover.
The same glow in amber for the thing running now.
A 1px amber outline with the amber glow. Visible on every control.
The cursor blinks at 1s. Log lines append without animation. Progress bars move linearly; nothing eases.
components_headline: Panels, prompts and a very square switch.
components_note: Kit components take Phosphor through the contract and come out square, green and 1px-edged. Authored classes add the prompt glyph, the glow and the state rows.
buttons: <Button>Run pipeline</Button><Button variant="secondary">Retry</Button><Button variant="outline">View logs</Button><Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button><button className="p-btn p-btn-primary">$ run</button><button className="p-btn">view logs</button><button className="p-btn p-btn-amber">running…</button>
buttons_note: Kit buttons on the left. Authored p-btn on the right: 1px edge, mono lowercase, the primary glows green on hover, the amber variant is reserved for the running job.
tags: passcachedskippedfail● pass● running● fail○ queued
tags_note: State tags are a filled or hollow dot plus the word. Three states only; queued is hollow.
fields_note: Fields are glass-sunk wells with a 1px edge; focus is amber. The switch is a square track with a square thumb.
stats:
Pass rate · 7d▲ 0.4 pts
Running nowjobs · amber glow
stats_note: A Stat is a label, a mono numeral, a delta. The live Stat glows amber; everything else is flat glass.
callouts:
No table called orderzDid you mean orders?
✓ 212 tests passed in 3m 12s on 4 workers.
! flaky: auth/session.test.ts retried once and passed.
✗ 3 failed · reader/hydration.test.ts:88 expected 2, got 3.
callouts_note: Callouts are log lines with a glyph: ✓ ! ✗. The ground tints toward the state; the text stays ink.
chart_comp_note: Charts are green first, cyan second. Gridlines are the line token; no area fills in Night because glow and fill fight.
table_note: Tables are the log: 1px rules, mono figures, state dots in the first column. The header is the label role.
card:
deploy-prod · #4812● running
$ npm run build
✓ islands built (14.2s)
✓ 12 gate shards queued
› gate-hydration · worker-3 · 00:42
card_note: A panel is a titled well. The live panel glows; a finished panel is flat. Logs inside are the log role with a prompt glyph per command.
motifs_headline: Dots, prompts, and a bar of light.
motifs_note: Phosphor draws with the dot grid, the prompt glyph and horizontal bars of green light. The data lives in the bars: a pipeline is a row of segments, a pass rate is a bar that fills.

motifs.title: The pipeline strip
motifs.usage: Each stage is a segment: filled green for pass, amber for running (glowing), hollow for queued, red for fail. Durations sit under each segment in the log role.

dos: One typeface. Size, weight and leading make the hierarchy.
Green for pass, amber for now, red for fail. Nothing else carries state.
Open on the command and its result.
Glow the one live thing; leave everything else flat.
donts: No rounded corners, no drop shadows, no gradients.
No second status colour; blue and violet exist only in charts.
No caps outside the label role.
binding_losses: The glow, the prompt glyph, the dot grid and the three-state tag rows have no contract slot; they are the --ds-glow properties and p-* classes above. The kit switch stays rounded, which is the one place Phosphor loses its square.
footer: Night first, Paper second. One family: IBM Plex Mono 400/500/700 and italic 400, Google-hosted.

queries.series: select run, stage, seconds from rows order by run, stage
queries.table: select job, state, worker, seconds from rows order by seconds desc
queries.totals: select 212 as tests, 3 as running, 99.7 as pass_rate from rows limit 1

data.tab_body: Summary: the state in one line, then the strip.

hand.headline: One-pixel green lines that glow.
hand.note: Phosphor draws like a vector display: 1.5px lines in phosphor green with a soft glow behind them, no fills except the dim glass of a panel and the one amber block. Lines are the drawing; light is the depth. In Paper mode the glow is off and the lines read as a printout.
rules: 1.5px green, square caps. Every edge is a lit line; nothing is a solid shape.
Dim glass for grounds; green for the one lit region; amber for the one thing running.
A wide 9px copy of every line at 30% behind it. Off in Paper.
The 16px dot grid behind drawings, at 40%.
Mono caps at 11px; the mono numeral for the one number.
Lines may blink once at 1s when they first appear; nothing else moves.

motion: Green glow appears on the hovered control, 120ms linear. Nothing moves.
The fill inverts for the duration of the press. No scale, no shadow.
A 1px amber outline with the amber glow. On every control.
Log lines append; nothing fades. Panels appear complete.
The cursor blinks at 1s, steps(1). One cursor per page.
Bars appear complete; a running series ends in an amber block that blinks with the cursor.

tpl.slide_title: gates went green on every run this week.
tpl.slide_sub: twelve shards, three containers, zero flakes since the hydration fix landed.
tpl.slide_body: of every thousand jobs this week, 997 passed first time. the three that did not were all one flaky suite, now quarantined.
tpl.ed_headline: the build that passed and should not have
tpl.ed_deck: a cached layer hid a failing migration for six hours. what the logs showed, what they did not, and the two checks that now run before every deploy.
tpl.ed_byline: by the platform team · 2 oct 2026 · 5 min read
tpl.ed_body: at 11:52 the deploy job reported green. the migration step had not run: a cached layer from the previous build satisfied the step and the runner never noticed the schema had changed underneath it. the first alert came from a customer, not a monitor. the fix is two lines, and the check that would have caught it is now a gate.
steps: one hundred jobs enter the queue.
each square is a job. sixty run on the fast pool, twenty-five on the gate containers, fifteen are cached and skip.
the fast pool is done. the gate containers are the long tail; the cached squares never ran at all.
tpl.step_caption: fig. 1 · one hundred jobs, by pool · synthetic
tpl.landing_eyebrow: phosphor · ci for people who read logs
tpl.landing_sub: a ci that shows the command, the output and the time, and never a mascot. three states, one typeface, no lies.
features: every run opens on its command and its output. no summary card stands between you and the line that failed.
pass, running, fail. amber marks the one thing happening now; nothing else is coloured.
every figure has a time. a number without a time is a rumour.
